bio.text: The Maricopa County Board of Supervisors appointed Elda Luna-Nájera in February 2024 to represent Legislative District 22, in the West Valley, in the Arizona House of Representatives.

According to the county announcement, she had served on the Tolleson Union High School District governing board since September 2020 and had worked at the Agua Fria Union High School District in Avondale since July 2016, managing programs on mental health, crisis intervention, homelessness and foster care.
She holds a doctorate in social work from the University of Southern California and a master's in social work from Arizona State University's West Campus.

sources.title: News Flash Archive - Board Appoints New District 22 Legislator
